video_summary.overall_goal: Complete a guided breathing exercise session
video_summary.description: User opens Brethap app, starts a breathing exercise session with 2-minute duration and 0 breaths, goes through inhale/exhale cycles, completes session, and returns to sessions list which shows sessions have been cleared.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Brethap main screen with blue header, 'Press Start' button in center, timer showing 0:02:00, and blue play button in bottom right
steps.system_response: App transitions to breathing session screen

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Session in progress screen showing 'Session, 0 Breaths' at bottom, large blue circle in center (inhale/exhale indicator), timer showing 0:01:55
steps.system_response: App guides user through breathing with visual circle animations
steps.visual_feedback: Blue circle expands/contracts to guide breathing, timer counts down

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Session screen showing 'Exhale' text above the breathing circle, large blue circle still visible, timer at 0:01:55
steps.system_response: App continues guiding exhale phase of breathing cycle
steps.visual_feedback: Blue circle may change size/opacity to indicate exhale, visual feedback on breathing phase

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Session continues with breathing circles and timer gradually reaching end, eventually transitioning to sessions list
steps.system_response: Session timer reaches 0:00:00, app automatically returns to Sessions screen
steps.navigation_change: Session screen to Sessions list screen
steps.visual_feedback: Timer counts down to zero, automatic screen transition

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Sessions screen with back arrow button, 'Sessions' title, empty session list area, 'Sessions cleared' message at bottom
steps.system_response: Sessions list displayed with status message
steps.visual_feedback: Message 'Sessions cleared' appears confirming session completion

overall_flow: User launches breathing session from main screen
App guides user through timed breathing exercise with visual circle animation
Session automatically ends when timer reaches zero
App returns to sessions list showing completion status
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens on the main screen with a 'Press Start' button and play button. The user taps the play button to begin a breathing session.
Step 2: The app transitions to the breathing session screen showing a large blue circle and timer counting down from 2 minutes. The user follows the visual breathing guide passively.
Step 3: The app displays 'Exhale' text and continues the breathing session with visual guidance, showing the exhale phase of the breathing cycle.
Step 4: The breathing session continues with the timer counting down until it reaches zero, at which point the app automatically transitions back to the sessions list.
Step 5: The app displays the Sessions screen with a 'Sessions cleared' message, indicating the breathing session has been completed and cleared from the list.
